product: Azure AI Speech — text to speech

source_audio.description: TTS input is a fixed Spanish sentence authored for this fixture ('El sistema registró la solicitud correctamente.') — no source recording exists, and the sentence names no real person, organisation or number. Rendered by the prebuilt neural voice es-CO-SalomeNeural; no custom or personal voice was used.

redaction.notes: Body bytes are the vendor's, unmodified — raw 8 kHz 16-bit mono PCM exactly as returned. The response carried no account, request or correlation identifier to strip: the full observed header set was content-type, date, server, x-envoy-upstream-service-time and strict-transport-security.

notes: 60200 bytes = 3.76 s at 8 kHz, 23% of the 256 KiB cap. The length is deliberately not a multiple of either chunk size (320 or 4096), which guarantees at least one partial frame reaches the consumer — something the previous new byte[320] and new byte[640] fixtures, exact multiples, could never produce. It does NOT follow that frames are uniformly chunk-sized: the provider yields whatever Stream.ReadAsync returns and real chunked responses do not align to the buffer, so only the byte-exact total and the presence of a partial frame are assertable. Measured content: amplitude -13338..+14757, RMS 2633, 23.7% zero samples from natural inter-word silence.
